title: [2.8.2.2 - dev] ISF lower than 2 mmol/l results in invalid profile
body:
When setting the ISF lower than 2. it will not validate the profile.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35005706/130351535-43903f64-4ab1-447b-a977-ba9931d655e1.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35005706/130351620-3b47560f-0b7a-4ffb-93bd-939239089a66.png)


It was still working correctly in 2.8.2 main.

Couldn't find the exact build where it goes wrong.
Multiple people on discord could validate this issue.

comments.body: Same issue here with 2.8.2.2 dev - when ISF is set below 2.0, profile cannot be saved.

part of the bug is in this place:
app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/utils/HardLimits.kt


        const val MIN_ISF = 2.0 // mgdl
        const val MAX_ISF = 720.0 // mgdl
        
 Apperently it is never translated to mmol/l.
 setting this limit on something lower, fixes the problem. 
 Real root cause still needs to be found.
 Maybe something to do with the refactoring in the last round.

Did a real fix now, added a check if it is in mgdl or mmol.
So changed the function in this. Did a little test, everything seems to work.
Please double check! and add it to the code base.
